settings.label: Search source (all / wyy / kuwo / bili)
settings.help: all = 网易云+酷我；wyy = 网易云音乐；kuwo = 酷我音乐；bili = B站(哔哩哔哩)。留空默认 all。B站走官方音轨，最高 192k（部分内容为 Hi-Res）。

settings.label: Download quality (lossless / high / standard)
settings.help: Overrides the app's playback quality for this plugin. Leave empty to follow the app setting. lossless = FLAC, high = MP3 320, standard = MP3 128. B站按档位映射到最高可用音轨。
